item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

item.tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Source and frame selection: Use talk-one.mp4; pick a clear frame yourself.
answer_sheet.Person: The woman speaking at the kitchen table in the attached video; keep her recognisable.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

must_haves: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE SIMPLE” in large, legible letters beside her face.
The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.
After the follow-up, the text reads exactly "MORNINGS MADE SIMPLE" where it read "MORNINGS MADE EASY"; everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, change “MORNINGS MADE EASY” to “MORNINGS MADE SIMPLE” and keep everything else exactly the same.

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

dialog.agent:
I can make that thumbnail, but the connected tools can’t extract a full frame from your MP4. Please upload a clear still—or a few screenshots, and I’ll pick the best one.

I’ll keep you recognisable, use a warm, upbeat look, and place **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters beside your face in a **16:9** layout.

turns.agent:
I found a face reference in your video, but Magic Hour refused the thumbnail generation because your account has insufficient credits. **No thumbnail was created.**

My chosen design is a warm cream-and-gold **16:9** layout, your recognisable face on the left, and **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in three big, dark-lettered lines on the right.

Once credits are available, I can retry without another upload.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a warm upbeat 16:9 YouTube thumbnail using this face reference extracted from the user's video. Preserve the exact recognizable identity, facial proportions, skin tone, hair and distinctive features of the reference person. Large realistic head-and-shoulders portrait on the LEFT, natural friendly expression, warm golden morning lighting. On the RIGHT, very large bold perfectly legible uppercase sans-serif lettering, exact words 'MORNINGS MADE EASY', arranged in three lines: MORNINGS / MADE / EASY. Dark rich brown lettering on a clean warm cream and golden peach background, strong contrast, subtle shadow, generous safe margins. Cheerful inviting polished thumbnail design readable on mobile. Soft minimal morning-inspired background, uncluttered, no other text, no logos, no watermark. Keep face unobscured and recognizable; don't replace the person with a generic face.
